sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接听了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟中最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，获取nytimes.com/subscribe上的特别优惠。

sentences.en: Fox News alert.
sentences.zh: 福克斯新闻快讯。

sentences.en: We have a deal for now.
sentences.zh: 我们目前达成了一项协议。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的瑞秋·艾布拉姆斯，这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: and Iran have both confirmed that they have agreed to a two-week pause.
sentences.zh: 和伊朗双方均已确认，他们已同意停火两周。

sentences.en: It appears Iran has accepted President Trump's terMs.
sentences.zh: 看来伊朗已经接受了特朗普总统的条件。

sentences.en: Subject to the immediate opening of the strait.
sentences.zh: 前提是立即开放海峡。

sentences.en: Just in, out of Iran, a statement read on state-run media instructing all military units to follow the Supreme Leader's order and stop firing.
sentences.zh: 刚刚从伊朗传出消息，官方媒体宣读了一份声明，指示所有军事单位听从最高领袖的命令，停止射击。

sentences.en: Just hours before a Trump-imposed deadline that could have led to a massive escalation in the war with Iran, the United States and Iran appeared to reach a temporary ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 就在特朗普设定的最后期限前几个小时，该期限本可能导致伊朗战争的大规模升级，美国和伊朗似乎达成了一项临时停火协议。

sentences.en: Today, Chief White House Correspondent David Sanger explains what led to this last-minute deal and what it would take to make it stick.
sentences.zh: 今天，白宫首席记者大卫·桑格将解释是什么促成了这项最后一刻的协议，以及要维持它需要做些什么。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, April 8th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月8日，星期三。

sentences.en: David Sanger, thank you so much for taping with us at 9.35 p.m.
sentences.zh: 大卫·桑格，非常感谢你在晚上9点35分接受我们的录制。

sentences.en: on this Tuesday night.
sentences.zh: 在这个周二的晚上。

sentences.en: It's been a wild day, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 这是疯狂的一天，瑞秋。

sentences.en: I can imagine.
sentences.zh: 我可以想象。

sentences.en: David, it feels like the entire world has been holding its breath for the last two days as President Trump ratcheted up the threats on Iran to open the Straits of Hormuz,
sentences.zh: 大卫，感觉全世界在过去两天里都屏住了呼吸，因为特朗普总统加剧了对伊朗开放霍尔木兹海峡的威胁，

sentences.en: which included Tuesday morning, when he basically threatened to wipe out the entire country.
sentences.zh: 其中包括周二早上，他基本上威胁要抹掉整个国家。

sentences.en: And just hours before the 8 p.m.
sentences.zh: 就在总统给伊朗达成协议设定的晚上8点

sentences.en: deadline that the president had given Iran to make a deal, both the United States and Iran announced that they'd reached some kind of temporary ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 最后期限前几个小时，美国和伊朗都宣布他们达成了一种临时停火协议。

sentences.en: What do we know about what they actually agreed to?
sentences.zh: 关于他们实际达成了什么协议，我们知道些什么？

sentences.en: Well, we've been trying to sort that out because the American accounts and the Iranian accounts, as you might imagine, don't completely match up.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们一直在努力理清这一点，因为正如你所料，美方的说法和伊方的说法并不完全吻合。

sentences.en: But what President Trump said was that Iran and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普总统所说的是，伊朗和美国

sentences.en: have agreed to a 14-day ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 已经同意停火14天。

sentences.en: During that time, he said, Iran would commit to making sure that the Strait of Hormuz would be fully reopened
sentences.zh: 他说，在此期间，伊朗将承诺确保霍尔木兹海峡完全重新开放，

sentences.en: and that that would allow this bottleneck of ships full of oil, full of fertilizer, full of helium for semiconductor production to begin flowing again
sentences.zh: 这将使装满石油、化肥、半导体生产所需氦气的船只瓶颈得以再次流动，

sentences.en: and relieve these huge shortages that have been wracking the world economy.
sentences.zh: 并缓解一直困扰世界经济的巨大短缺问题。

sentences.en: We don't know exactly when that will happen, but the American bombing of Iran stopped almost immediately.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道这具体何时会发生，但美国对伊朗的轰炸几乎立即停止了。

sentences.en: Okay, so that is what Trump agreed to, David.
sentences.zh: 好的，这就是特朗普同意的内容，大卫。

sentences.en: But you mentioned that it did not really seem like both sides were on the same page when the ceasefire was first announced.
sentences.zh: 但你提到，当停火协议首次宣布时，双方似乎并不在同一个频道上。

sentences.en: What if the Iranians said that they agreed to?
sentences.zh: 伊朗人说他们同意了什么？

sentences.en: Well, if you just read President Trump's announcement, you'd think that the Strait of Hormuz was just being thrown wide open, the way it was before the war started.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果你只读特朗普总统的声明，你会认为霍尔木兹海峡就像战争开始前那样被完全敞开了。

sentences.en: But if you read the statement that came out a few minutes later from Iran's foreign minister,
sentences.zh: 但如果你读一下几分钟后伊朗外交部长发表的声明，

sentences.en: Abbas Aragachi, who's quite experienced, has been involved in many of these negotiations over the years,
sentences.zh: 阿巴斯·阿拉格希，他非常有经验，多年来参与了许多此类谈判，

sentences.en: he said that Iran will cease their defensive operation for a period of two weeks and that safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz would only be possible
sentences.zh: 他说伊朗将在两周内停止防御行动，并且只有通过与伊朗武装部队协调，

sentences.en: by coordinating with Iran's armed forces.
sentences.zh: 才可能通过霍尔木兹海峡。

sentences.en: So that means that in the Iranian vision, the Iranian military will retain the control that it seized in the past five or six weeks.
sentences.zh: 这意味着在伊朗的设想中，伊朗军方将保留其在过去五六周内夺取的控制权。

sentences.en: And who knows at what pace they're going to allow ships to pass, whether or not they're going to allow them to just pass freely or charge them tolls.
sentences.zh: 谁知道他们会以什么速度允许船只通过，他们是否会允许船只自由通过还是收取通行费。

sentences.en: We just don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们只是不知道。

sentences.en: OK, so obviously some daylight between these two statements, room for interpretation.
sentences.zh: 好的，显然这两个声明之间存在一些差异，有解读的空间。

sentences.en: But we have not talked about another country that is a major actor here, and that is Israel.
sentences.zh: 但我们还没有谈到另一个在这里扮演重要角色的国家，那就是以色列。

sentences.en: Israel, of course, attacked Iran along with the United States.
sentences.zh: 以色列当然与美国一起袭击了伊朗。

sentences.en: That is how this war started.
sentences.zh: 这就是这场战争开始的方式。

sentences.en: Has Israel said anything about this agreement?
sentences.zh: 以色列对这项协议有什么说法吗？

sentences.en: Do we know that they are party to it?
sentences.zh: 我们知道他们是协议的一方吗？

sentences.en: Where do they stand?
sentences.zh: 他们的立场是什么？

sentences.en: Well, the White House told us that Israel had agreed to the terMs.
sentences.zh: 嗯，白宫告诉我们以色列已经同意了这些条件。

sentences.en: And then later in the evening, the Israelis turned out a statement from the prime minister's office saying they support President Trump's decision.
sentences.zh: 后来在晚上，以色列总理办公室发表了一份声明，称他们支持特朗普总统的决定。

sentences.en: But it was interesting wording because they didn't say that they were terribly enthused about it.
sentences.zh: 但措辞很有趣，因为他们并没有说他们对此感到非常热衷。

sentences.en: I just want to step back for a second, David, because it feels kind of stunning that literally just a few hours ago, this threat to wipe out an entire country was on the table.
sentences.zh: 大卫，我想退后一步，因为令人震惊的是，就在几个小时前，抹掉整个国家的威胁还摆在桌面上。

sentences.en: The two sides weren't even talking to each other.
sentences.zh: 双方甚至没有进行对话。

sentences.en: We had no idea what this threat meant.
sentences.zh: 我们根本不知道这个威胁意味着什么。

sentences.en: It just sort of felt like any possible option was on the table until very, very recently.
sentences.zh: 直到最近，感觉任何可能的选项似乎都摆在桌面上。

sentences.en: So how did we get to this point where we are now with both sides having reached a temporary ceasefire agreement?
sentences.zh: 那么我们是如何走到现在这一步，双方都达成了临时停火协议的呢？

sentences.en: Well, Rachel, you'll remember, as we've discussed on earlier shows,
sentences.zh: 嗯，瑞秋，你会记得，正如我们在之前的节目中讨论过的那样，

sentences.en: the president was feeling more and more pressure as the effects of the Strait of Hormuz was spreading around the world.
sentences.zh: 随着霍尔木兹海峡的影响蔓延到世界各地，总统感受到的压力越来越大。

sentences.en: So at first he lashed out and he said to the Iranians, you have 48 hours to get the Strait back open.
sentences.zh: 所以起初他猛烈抨击，并对伊朗人说，你们有48小时让海峡重新开放。

sentences.en: And the Iranians kind of ignored him.
sentences.zh: 而伊朗人基本上无视了他。

sentences.en: And then starting on March 26th, he said, OK, there are 10 days to get a negotiation going.
sentences.zh: 然后从3月26日开始，他说，好吧，有10天时间来进行谈判。

sentences.en: So he set this 10-day clock essentially to Tuesday evening at 8 p.m.
sentences.zh: 所以他基本上设定了这个10天的倒计时，直到周二晚上8点。

sentences.en: But as the weekend approached, the Iranians were ignoring him.
sentences.zh: 但随着周末临近，伊朗人一直在无视他。

sentences.en: There was very little communication underway.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有任何沟通在进行。

sentences.en: And the Iranians were mocking the president on social media for all of his changing deadlines.
sentences.zh: 而且伊朗人在社交媒体上嘲笑总统不断变化的最后期限。

sentences.en: Then this all got interrupted by a sudden crisis that distracted everyone from all of this.
sentences.zh: 然后这一切被一场突然的危机打断了，分散了所有人的注意力。

sentences.en: This was, of course, the shoot down of the F-15E fighter jet on Friday.
sentences.zh: 这当然就是周五F-15E战斗机的坠毁事件。

sentences.en: The pilot and the weapons officer both ejected and no one could find the weapons officer.
sentences.zh: 飞行员和武器官都弹射逃生了，但没人能找到武器官。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That was actually the subject of Tuesday's episode, this unbelievably daring, costly rescue operation of this weapons officer, which they pulled off on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 那实际上是周二那一集的主题，这次令人难以置信的大胆、代价高昂的武器官救援行动，他们在周六成功完成了。

sentences.en: And that, as our colleague Eric Schmidt told us, seems to have emboldened President Trump
sentences.zh: 正如我们的同事埃里克·施密特告诉我们的那样，这似乎让特朗普总统更加大胆了，

sentences.en: as he sort of begins to pick up where he left off with these negotiations and threats with Iran.
sentences.zh: 因为他开始在某种程度上从他与伊朗的这些谈判和威胁中断的地方继续下去。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And remember, before the shoot down of the plane, the president had hinted that if the Iranians don't relent, he was going to begin to go after power plants, he said.
sentences.zh: 记住，在飞机坠毁之前，总统曾暗示如果伊朗人不让步，他说他将开始攻击发电厂。

sentences.en: And he suggested other infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 他还建议攻击其他基础设施。

sentences.en: And the Iranians came back and basically said, if you wipe out our power plants, you can say goodbye to the power plants around the Gulf.
sentences.zh: 伊朗人回击说，基本上，如果你摧毁我们的发电厂，你就可以告别海湾周围的发电厂了。

sentences.en: Of course, all of this was put aside during the hunt for the missing airmen.
sentences.zh: 当然，在搜寻失踪飞行员期间，所有这些都被搁置了。

sentences.en: But by Sunday morning, Easter Sunday, the president was over the high of retrieving the colonel, and he was right back in his set of demands.
sentences.zh: 但到了周日早上，复活节周日，总统已经从救回上校的兴奋中平复下来，他又回到了他的一系列要求中。

sentences.en: And that's what turned out to be the first of two truly bizarre social media posts.
sentences.zh: 而这正是后来被证明是两次真正离奇的社交媒体帖子中的第一次。

sentences.en: And what was that post?
sentences.zh: 那条帖子是什么？

sentences.en: Well, I'll read it to you, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我读给你听，瑞秋。

sentences.en: Tuesday will be power plant day and bridge day, all wrapped up in one in Iran.
sentences.zh: 周二将是伊朗的发电厂日和桥梁日，合二为一。

sentences.en: Open the fucking straight, you crazy bastards, or you'll be living in hell.
sentences.zh: 打开该死的海峡，你们这些疯子，否则你们将生活在地狱里。

sentences.en: Just watch.
sentences.zh: 等着瞧。

sentences.en: So we'll set aside for a moment the pretty undiplomatic language.
sentences.zh: 所以我们暂时撇开这种非常不外交的语言不谈。

sentences.en: It actually led people to believe that the president might be willing to go escalate and escalate significantly in a way that would get us even deeper into this war.
sentences.zh: 它实际上让人们相信总统可能愿意升级，而且是以一种会让我们更深地卷入这场战争的方式进行重大升级。

sentences.en: So basically, by Sunday, it sounds like two very important things have happened.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，到周日，听起来发生了两件非常重要的事情。

sentences.en: One is that the White House is crowing from this huge victory of rescuing this airman and this daring operation.
sentences.zh: 一是白宫正在为营救这名飞行员和这次大胆行动的巨大胜利而欢呼。

sentences.en: But countering that is the fact that the president is still not getting what he wants from Iran.
sentences.zh: 但与之相对的是，总统仍然没有从伊朗那里得到他想要的东西。

sentences.en: And as you mentioned, the tension is ratcheting up.
sentences.zh: 正如你所提到的，紧张局势正在加剧。

sentences.en: And this Tuesday night deadline is looming and they are barreling toward it.
sentences.zh: 周二晚上的最后期限即将来临，他们正全速冲向它。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And on Monday, the president dug the hole even deeper.
sentences.zh: 周一，总统把坑挖得更深了。

sentences.en: First, he went out on the South Lawn during what's usually the very charming Easter egg roll with children running around.
sentences.zh: 首先，他在通常非常迷人的复活节滚彩蛋活动中出现在南草坪，周围都是孩子。

sentences.en: And standing next to the Easter bunny, he began to ratchet up the threats to Iran and talk about the depth to which he would destroy their infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 站在复活节兔子旁边，他开始加剧对伊朗的威胁，并谈论他将摧毁他们基础设施的程度。

sentences.en: And then he began to say, you know, we will destroy Iran's bridges,
sentences.zh: 然后他开始说，你知道，我们将摧毁伊朗的桥梁、

sentences.en: their electric power plants and so forth, and we will do it in hours on a scale no one has ever seen before.
sentences.zh: 他们的发电厂等等，我们将在几小时内以史无前例的规模完成。

sentences.en: It was more specific and therefore it seemed, again, like it was ratcheting up this rhetoric.
sentences.zh: 这更具体，因此看起来再次像是升级了这种言论。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And here in the office, we were asking the same question that was being asked all over the country, which is,
sentences.zh: 在办公室里，我们问着全国各地都在问的同一个问题，那就是，

sentences.en: was he truly determined to go that much deeper into an unpopular war or was he simply using these threats as a tactic to try to see if he could get the Iranian system moving?
sentences.zh: 他是否真的决心更深地卷入一场不受欢迎的战争，还是他只是在利用这些威胁作为一种策略，试图看看能否让伊朗系统动起来？

sentences.en: And then Tuesday morning, just as people were pouring their coffee at a little after eight in the morning, comes another social media message that actually rivaled the Sunday one.
sentences.zh: 然后周二早上，就在人们在早上八点多倒咖啡的时候，又出现了一条社交媒体信息，实际上可以与周日的那条相媲美。

sentences.en: Let me read that one to you, too, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 让我把那条也读给你听，瑞秋。

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: 请读。

sentences.en: A whole civilization will die tonight, never to be brought back again.
sentences.zh: 整个文明今晚将消亡，永远不会再回来。

sentences.en: I don't want that to happen, but it probably will.
sentences.zh: 我不希望这种情况发生，但很可能会发生。

sentences.en: However, now that we have complete and total regime change where different, smarter, less radicalized minds prevail, maybe something revolutionarily wonderful can happen.
sentences.zh: 然而，既然我们已经实现了彻底的政权更迭，不同的、更聪明的、不那么激进的思想占了上风，也许会发生一些革命性的美妙事情。

sentences.en: Who knows?
sentences.zh: 谁知道呢？

sentences.en: We'll find out tonight.
sentences.zh: 我们今晚就会知道。

sentences.en: Even for a president that breaks norms all the time in terms of how he speaks to the public and the threats that he makes, the rhetoric that he makes,
sentences.zh: 即使对于一位在与公众交谈方式、所作威胁以及所用言辞方面总是打破常规的总统来说，

sentences.en: this social media post was far beyond anything we had ever heard Trump say before.
sentences.zh: 这条社交媒体帖子远远超出了我们以前听到的特朗普所说的任何话。

sentences.en: This was a threat to wipe out 90 million people.
sentences.zh: 这是对抹掉9000万人的威胁。

sentences.en: That's right, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 没错，瑞秋。

sentences.en: Certainly that's how I think we read it and most everyone read it.
sentences.zh: 当然，我想我们是这样解读的，几乎每个人都是这样解读的。

sentences.en: And it suggested many different things.
sentences.zh: 它暗示了许多不同的事情。

sentences.en: I mean, the first is the president wasn't simply discussing defeating the Iranian government or going after nuclear sites here.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，首先，总统不仅仅是在讨论击败伊朗政府或攻击核设施。

sentences.en: He was talking about committing what would essentially be a huge war crime.
sentences.zh: 他是在谈论犯下本质上是巨大战争罪的行为。

sentences.en: And there was response all over the place.
sentences.zh: 到处都有回应。

sentences.en: I think that Trump has lost his mind.
sentences.zh: 我认为特朗普疯了。

sentences.en: He is unfit to serve as our president.
sentences.zh: 他不适合担任我们的总统。

sentences.en: He's not capable of being the president.
sentences.zh: 他没有能力担任总统。

sentences.en: Democrats, of course, were calling for invoking the 25th Amendment, you know,
sentences.zh: 民主党人当然在呼吁援引第25修正案，你知道，

sentences.en: in which the cabinet meets and determines that the president is unable to carry out his duties and temporarily puts the vice president in place.
sentences.zh: 内阁开会并确定总统无法履行职责，并暂时由副总统接替。

sentences.en: His cabinet has a responsibility.
sentences.zh: 他的内阁有责任。

sentences.en: And we need to be invoking the 25th Amendment.
sentences.zh: 我们需要援引第25修正案。

sentences.en: He should be removed using the 25th Amendment immediately.
sentences.zh: 他应该立即被援引第25修正案罢免。

sentences.en: But it wasn't just Democrats.
sentences.zh: 但不仅仅是民主党人。

sentences.en: How do we 25th Amendmentize?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何援引第25修正案？

sentences.en: Even within the MAGA movement, there were great critics of this.
sentences.zh: 即使在MAGA运动内部，也有对此的强烈批评者。

sentences.en: Alex Jones.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·琼斯。

sentences.en: The problem is to get the 25th Amendment's harder than impeachment.
sentences.zh: 问题是援引第25修正案比弹劾更难。

sentences.en: You have to get two-thirds of the House and two-thirds of the Senate to determine it.
sentences.zh: 你必须获得众议院三分之二和参议院三分之二的投票才能确定。

sentences.en: So what do we do?
sentences.zh: 那么我们该怎么办？

sentences.en: Tackle Trump and let him pretend he's president and publicly report that he's going through a health issue and Vance take over.
sentences.zh: 制服特朗普，让他假装自己是总统，并公开报告他正在经历健康问题，让万斯接管。

sentences.en: It literally needs to be something like that.
sentences.zh: 确实需要类似这样的事情。

sentences.en: It's that bad.
sentences.zh: 情况就是这么糟糕。

sentences.en: Marjorie Taylor Greene and Candace Owens, who were talking about the 25th Amendment.
sentences.zh: 玛乔丽·泰勒·格林和坎迪斯·欧文斯，她们在谈论第25修正案。

sentences.en: Candace Owens says the 25th Amendment needs to be invoked.
sentences.zh: 坎迪斯·欧文斯说需要援引第25修正案。

sentences.en: He is a genocidal lunatic.
sentences.zh: 他是一个种族灭绝的疯子。

sentences.en: Tucker Carlson called Mr. Trump's post vile.
sentences.zh: 塔克·卡尔森称特朗普先生的帖子卑劣。

sentences.en: It is vile on every level.
sentences.zh: 这在任何层面上都是卑劣的。

sentences.en: And suggested that...
sentences.zh: 并建议……

sentences.en: Those people who are in direct contact with the president need to say, no, all resigned.
sentences.zh: 那些与总统有直接联系的人需要说“不”，全部辞职。

sentences.en: Maybe people shouldn't be following these kinds of orders.
sentences.zh: 也许人们不应该执行这类命令。

sentences.en: I'll do whatever I can do legally to stop this because this is insane.
sentences.zh: 我会尽我所能合法地阻止这一切，因为这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: And if given the order, I'm not carrying it out.
sentences.zh: 如果接到命令，我也不会执行。

sentences.en: And then there are some like Senator Ron Johnson of Wisconsin, who's usually a little more reticent about criticizing the president,
sentences.zh: 还有一些人，比如威斯康星州的参议员罗恩·约翰逊，他通常对批评总统比较谨慎，

sentences.en: who said this simply is not how Americans speak and how presidents ought to speak.
sentences.zh: 他说这根本不是美国人说话的方式，也不是总统该有的说话方式。

sentences.en: I do not want to see us start blowing up civilian infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 我不希望看到我们开始炸毁民用基础设施。

sentences.en: I do not want to see that.
sentences.zh: 我不希望看到那样。

sentences.en: We are not at war with the Iranian people.
sentences.zh: 我们并非与伊朗人民处于战争状态。

sentences.en: We are trying to liberate them.
sentences.zh: 我们是在试图解放他们。

sentences.en: So by the end of the day, David, what have you and our colleagues learned about how real this threat is?
sentences.zh: 那么大卫，到今天结束时，你和我们的同事了解到这个威胁有多真实了吗？

sentences.en: Like, is there evidence that the military has mobilized in any way to launch any kind of massive attack?
sentences.zh: 比如，有没有证据表明军方已经以任何方式动员起来发动某种大规模袭击？

sentences.en: Well, we saw lots of mobilization of aircraft moving from the United States to Europe and Europe on to the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们看到了大量飞机从美国调往欧洲，又从欧洲调往中东。

sentences.en: But we've been seeing that for the past five weeks.
sentences.zh: 但过去五周我们一直都在看到这种情况。

sentences.en: So it was hard to tell whether this was more of the same or a true escalation.
sentences.zh: 所以很难判断这到底是常态还是真正的升级。

sentences.en: But certainly there were so many American forces in the Middle East that if the president wanted to make good on this threat, he could.
sentences.zh: 但可以肯定的是，中东有如此多的美军，如果总统想兑现这个威胁，他是做得到的。

sentences.en: And, of course, the clock was ticking all day on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 当然，周二一整天时间都在流逝。

sentences.en: But we were still hearing the echoes of some kind of negotiation taking place indirectly through the Pakistani foreign minister and the Pakistani prime minister.
sentences.zh: 但我们仍然听到一些通过巴基斯坦外交部长和巴基斯坦总理进行间接谈判的回声。

sentences.en: And then, at a little after six o'clock, the president announced that he was once again calling a timeout here.
sentences.zh: 然后，在六点多一点，总统宣布他再次在这里叫了暂停。

sentences.en: Suddenly, there was a ceasefire, a new two-week-long deadline, and everyone from market investors to the military to many around the Gulf just breathed this huge sigh of relief.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，停火了，有了新的两周最后期限，从市场投资者到军方，再到海湾地区的许多人，都长舒了一口气。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《Connections》谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你们刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: So, David, as you described, this moment of ceasefire seems to be this huge relief.
sentences.zh: 那么大卫，正如你所描述的，这一停火时刻似乎让人如释重负。

sentences.en: But how real does this deal actually feel?
sentences.zh: 但这项协议实际上有多真实呢？

sentences.en: And what does it actually mean?
sentences.zh: 它到底意味着什么？

sentences.en: Well, it could mean the end of this war, or it could mean just a brief pause.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它可能意味着这场战争的结束，也可能只意味着短暂的暂停。

sentences.en: Ceasefires are fragile by nature.
sentences.zh: 停火本质上是脆弱的。

sentences.en: We're going to have to see if anybody violates it.
sentences.zh: 我们得看看是否有人违反它。

sentences.en: And even if they have the discipline to keep it in place, we have to determine if the traffic
sentences.zh: 即使他们有纪律维持停火，我们也必须确定

sentences.en: that's going through the Strait of Hormuz is getting back to what it was before February
sentences.zh: 通过霍尔木兹海峡的交通是否正在恢复到二月之前的水平，

sentences.en: 28th when the fighting broke out.
sentences.zh: 也就是战斗爆发之前。

sentences.en: And, of course, we're going to be in a situation now where the Iranian military actually still controls who's going through the Strait.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们现在将处于一种伊朗军方实际上仍然控制着谁能通过海峡的局面。

sentences.en: That wasn't the case back in February.
sentences.zh: 二月份的时候情况并非如此。

sentences.en: For the president, he said, basically, it's got to go back to the way it was.
sentences.zh: 对于总统来说，他基本上说，一切必须恢复原样。

sentences.en: But the fact of the matter is, the Iranians have now discovered this is their greatest leverage, and it's not a power they are likely to give up any time soon.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，伊朗人现在发现这是他们最大的筹码，他们不太可能很快放弃这种权力。

sentences.en: So, is that the biggest test of the ceasefire, whether we see all these ships going through the Strait?
sentences.zh: 那么，这是否是停火的最大考验，即我们是否看到所有这些船只通过海峡？

sentences.en: That's the immediate test of the ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 这是停火的直接考验。

sentences.en: But remember, the ceasefire is only the means to an end.
sentences.zh: 但请记住，停火只是达到目的的一种手段。

sentences.en: And its purpose is to allow the time and space to go negotiate on the bigger issues.
sentences.zh: 其目的是为了留出时间和空间去协商更大的问题。

sentences.en: It took two and a half years, Rachel, to negotiate the 2015 agreement between the Obama administration and the Iranians.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋，奥巴马政府与伊朗人在2015年达成协议花了两年半的时间。

sentences.en: And that was in peacetime.
sentences.zh: 而且那还是在和平时期。

sentences.en: You can imagine how difficult it will be now at a moment when the Iranians feel like this war left them empowered.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，现在在伊朗人觉得这场战争让他们变得更强大的时刻，这会有多困难。

sentences.en: To that point, at the outset of the war, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 说到这一点，在战争开始时，美国

sentences.en: said that one of its big reasons for going to war was, in fact, to, among other reasons, keep Iran from making a nuclear weapon.
sentences.zh: 表示其发动战争的一大原因，实际上是为了（除其他原因外）阻止伊朗制造核武器。

sentences.en: That feels very absent from these discussions.
sentences.zh: 这在这些讨论中似乎非常缺失。

sentences.en: Why is that?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Well, the nuclear weapons issue is presumably the first issue they're going to have to take up in these negotiations over the next two weeks.
sentences.zh: 嗯，核武器问题大概是他们在接下来的两周谈判中必须首先处理的问题。

sentences.en: And it's going to be hard.
sentences.zh: 而且这会很困难。

sentences.en: And the reason it's going to be hard is, first of all, the president himself has been all over the map here.
sentences.zh: 之所以困难，首先是因为总统本人在这里的态度一直反复无常。

sentences.en: Before the war broke out, he said the United States cannot tolerate Iran having any nuclear material, any of its stockpile left in the country.
sentences.zh: 战争爆发前，他说美国不能容忍伊朗拥有任何核材料，不能容忍国内留有任何库存。

sentences.en: It all had to go.
sentences.zh: 必须全部清除。

sentences.en: Then, about a week and a half ago, he said, you know, I don't really care.
sentences.zh: 然后，大约一周半前，他说，你知道，我其实不在乎。

sentences.en: It's buried so deep, we can watch it by satellite.
sentences.zh: 它埋得太深了，我们可以通过卫星监视它。

sentences.en: And now, it's likely he's back to the negotiating position they were taking before the war, which is Iran cannot be left with any nuclear material.
sentences.zh: 而现在，他很可能回到了战前采取的谈判立场，即伊朗不能保留任何核材料。

sentences.en: And if the president left a significant amount of near bomb-grade uranium in Iran, he would be getting less out of the Iranians than Barack Obama got out of them in 2015.
sentences.zh: 如果总统在伊朗留下了大量接近武器级的铀，那么他从伊朗人那里得到的成果将比巴拉克·奥巴马在2015年得到的还要少。

sentences.en: And frankly, it's hard to imagine that the president wants to read that he went to war with Iran and didn't get the material that was the reason for this conflict at the start.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，很难想象总统会想读到这样的报道：他与伊朗开战，却没能得到当初引发这场冲突的那些材料。

sentences.en: Well, that makes me wonder about the effectiveness of these talks overall and how we should be
sentences.zh: 嗯，这让我怀疑这些会谈的整体有效性，以及我们应该如何

sentences.en: thinking about them, the threat to annihilate a whole country, is that something that brought
sentences.zh: 看待它们，威胁要消灭整个国家，这是促使

sentences.en: them to the table for meaningful negotiations to end the war and get demands that the United
sentences.zh: 他们坐到谈判桌前进行有意义的谈判以结束战争并满足美国

sentences.en: States actually wanted?
sentences.zh: 真正想要的要求的事情吗？

sentences.en: Or is this ceasefire just a temporary de-escalation that serves to save face more than anything else?
sentences.zh: 还是说这次停火只是一次暂时的降级，更多是为了挽回面子？

sentences.en: It gains nothing we didn't have before the war began.
sentences.zh: 它没有获得任何我们在战争开始前没有的东西。

sentences.en: But I think you have to give credit to the president, because this ratcheting up of pressure certainly played some role in forcing an agreement.
sentences.zh: 但我认为你必须给总统记上一功，因为这种压力的升级确实在迫使达成协议方面发挥了一定作用。

sentences.en: It's not clear whether or not it actually terrified the Iranians, because their decision-making
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚这是否真的吓坏了伊朗人，因为他们的决策

sentences.en: process is so spread out among the military and the clerics and so forth, it's not clear who was making these decisions.
sentences.zh: 过程分散在军方、神职人员等各个层面，不清楚是谁在做这些决定。

sentences.en: But it certainly scared the region.
sentences.zh: 但它确实吓坏了该地区。

sentences.en: And I think it scared the Chinese, who were highly dependent on oil moving through the strait.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为它吓坏了高度依赖通过海峡运输石油的中国人。

sentences.en: So there were pressure points that the president was able to take advantage of.
sentences.zh: 所以总统确实利用了一些压力点。

sentences.en: David, on the off chance that this temporary ceasefire leads to a permanent ceasefire, what will the White House, what will the United States have actually gained from all of this?
sentences.zh: 大卫，万一这次临时停火演变成永久停火，白宫，美国，从这一切中到底获得了什么？

sentences.en: Look, I think the United States and the Israelis have accomplished a lot.
sentences.zh: 看，我认为美国和以色列已经完成了很多事情。

sentences.en: They took out, in the opening hours of the war, the supreme leader.
sentences.zh: 在战争开始的最初几个小时，他们除掉了最高领袖。

sentences.en: They devastated levels of the military and intelligence and nuclear establishment.
sentences.zh: 他们摧毁了军事、情报和核设施的各个层面。

sentences.en: They set back the missile program and the missile production program.
sentences.zh: 他们挫败了导弹计划和导弹生产计划。

sentences.en: But if this ceasefire essentially becomes permanent with no change in Iran beyond the restoration of traffic in the Strait of Hormuz, then the White House will have accomplished
sentences.zh: 但如果这次停火在除了恢复霍尔木兹海峡的交通外，伊朗没有任何改变的情况下基本上变成了永久性的，那么白宫将几乎

sentences.en: virtually none of its major goals.
sentences.zh: 没有实现其任何主要目标。

sentences.en: The country is still run by a military and theocratic group of elites who have terrorized their own population.
sentences.zh: 这个国家仍然由一群恐吓自己民众的军事和神权精英统治。

sentences.en: They still have their nuclear material and could, in theory, try to go rebuild and race for a bomb.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然拥有核材料，理论上可以尝试重建并竞相制造炸弹。

sentences.en: They still have missile supplies and drones, not on the scale that they did before the attacks, but we've learned that they could rebuild fairly quickly.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然拥有导弹供应和无人机，规模虽不及袭击前，但我们已经了解到他们可以相当快地重建。

sentences.en: And most importantly, I think they still have a sense that they were able to stand up to the
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，我认为他们仍然有一种感觉，即他们能够对抗

sentences.en: United States and Israel and resist against a much larger invading force.
sentences.zh: 美国和以色列，并抵御了一支规模大得多的入侵部队。

sentences.en: David, we've talked on the show quite a bit about how you can't put everything back together that has
sentences.zh: 大卫，我们在节目中谈论了很多关于你无法修复一切

sentences.en: been broken by this war, meaning that the economic impacts, the political impacts are not going to just go back to the status quo.
sentences.zh: 被这场战争破坏的东西，意思是经济影响、政治影响不会仅仅回到现状。

sentences.en: Even if the war ends tonight or in two weeks, so much infrastructure has been destroyed.
sentences.zh: 即使战争今晚或两周后结束，如此多的基础设施已经被摧毁。

sentences.en: So much has been done to make these impacts ripple for potentially years to come.
sentences.zh: 为了让这些影响在未来几年内持续发酵，已经做了太多事情。

sentences.en: And so I wonder what consequences specifically you think, as of this moment, feel like they are enduring.
sentences.zh: 所以我很想知道，你认为此时此刻，哪些后果感觉是持久的。

sentences.en: Well, a few things.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有几件事。

sentences.en: First of all, the Iranians have discovered that they have a greater power than they knew over commerce around the world.
sentences.zh: 首先，伊朗人发现他们对世界各地的商业拥有比他们所知更大的权力。

sentences.en: Second, the Gulf states feel more vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 其次，海湾国家感到更加脆弱。

sentences.en: They've built these big, beautiful cities full of skyscrapers, and they've entered the 21st century.
sentences.zh: 他们建造了这些宏伟、美丽的摩天大楼城市，并进入了21世纪。

sentences.en: And what do they discover?
sentences.zh: 结果他们发现了什么？

sentences.en: That the Iranians can put missiles through their windows and through their desalination plants.
sentences.zh: 伊朗人可以把导弹穿过他们的窗户，穿过他们的海水淡化厂。

sentences.en: The world economy feels more fragile because we've discovered yet another supply chain vulnerability.
sentences.zh: 世界经济感觉更加脆弱，因为我们发现了另一个供应链漏洞。

sentences.en: And we've discovered that while the United States thought one more time that it had gotten out of the Middle East, an explicit goal in the president's national
sentences.zh: 而且我们发现，虽然美国再次认为它已经退出了中东，这是总统国家

sentences.en: security strategy that came out last fall, in fact, it's been sucked back in on a scale few could have imagined even a few months ago.
sentences.zh: 安全战略中明确的目标，该战略去年秋天发布，但事实上，它以一种几个月前几乎没人能想象的规模被卷了回来。

sentences.en: And I think there's a last thing we've learned.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们还学到了最后一件事。

sentences.en: The world's never really approved of the amount of power the United States has had.
sentences.zh: 世界从未真正认可美国所拥有的权力总量。

sentences.en: But it's usually signed up to the thought that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但它通常认同美国

sentences.en: was fundamentally a benevolent superpower in the paSt. And yet, I think we lost a lot of that reputation in this attack on Iran.
sentences.zh: 在过去本质上是一个仁慈的超级大国的想法。然而，我认为我们在这次对伊朗的袭击中失去了很多那种声誉。

sentences.en: That there was a sense that the president was never committed to the February diplomacy.
sentences.zh: 有一种感觉是总统从未致力于二月份的外交。

sentences.en: That there was a sense that he thought he could topple a weak regime.
sentences.zh: 有一种感觉是他认为自己可以推翻一个软弱的政权。

sentences.en: That he could go out and threaten the lives of 92 million people.
sentences.zh: 他可以走出去威胁9200万人的生命。

sentences.en: And that the threat came from a president who oversees the world's the world's most powerful military.
sentences.zh: 而这种威胁来自一位监管着世界上最强大军队的总统。

sentences.en: And so eventually, gas prices will come down.
sentences.zh: 所以最终，汽油价格会下降。

sentences.en: And eventually, oil will flow more naturally.
sentences.zh: 最终，石油会更自然地流动。

sentences.en: And over time, the damage of the war will be rebuilt the way it was in Japan and Germany and Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，战争造成的破坏将像在日本、德国和越南那样得到重建。

sentences.en: But whether the world ever views the United States quite the way it did before this happened, I'm not sure that's going to be back for a long time.
sentences.zh: 但世界是否还会像这件事发生前那样看待美国，我不确定这种看法在很长一段时间内能否恢复。

sentences.en: David Sanger, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 大卫·桑格，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，瑞秋。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: Shelley Kittleson, an American journalist who was abducted in Baghdad by an Iraqi militia aligned with Iran, was freed on Tuesday after a week in captivity.
sentences.zh: 谢莉·基特尔森，一位在巴格达被与伊朗结盟的伊拉克民兵绑架的美国记者，在被囚禁一周后于周二获释。

sentences.en: Kittleson has reported on the
sentences.zh: 基特尔森曾为多家新闻机构报道

sentences.en: Middle East for more than a decade for various news outlets.
sentences.zh: 中东新闻十多年。

sentences.en: And she was set free in exchange for the release of several imprisoned members of the militia.
sentences.zh: 她获释是为了换取几名被监禁的民兵成员的释放。

sentences.en: The kidnapping comes amid growing anxieties about
sentences.zh: 这次绑架发生之际，人们对

sentences.en: Iranian-backed militias attacking American targets since the United States and Israel-led war with Iran began.
sentences.zh: 自美国和以色列领导的对伊战争开始以来，伊朗支持的民兵组织袭击美国目标的焦虑日益增加。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严格控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党就陷入了一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和莎拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《Metro》节目中，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。
